description: This Java class, GuarantorWorkbookPopulator, is responsible for generating and populating a spreadsheet workbook with template data related to guarantors, including office, client, loan, savings, and relationship type information, for bulk import purposes in a financial application.

classes.name: GuarantorWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates an Excel workbook sheet with guarantor-related data including offices, clients, loans, savings, and relationship types, along with setting data validation rules and named ranges for bulk import workflows.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to populate the workbook with guarantor data, set layout, populate tables for loans and savings, relationship types, and rules.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Initial setup of sheet layout, column widths, and header labels.

methods.name: populateSavingsTable
methods.description: Populates the sheet with savings account data entries.

methods.name: populateLoansTable
methods.description: Populates the sheet with loan account data entries.

methods.name: populateGuarantorRelationshipTypes
methods.description: Populates the sheet with guarantor relationship types.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Defines data validation rules for various columns, including dropdown lists tied to named ranges.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Defines named ranges for offices, clients, account numbers, savings, and relationship types for use in dropdowns and data validation.
